ops.body: Root taking the next source repair. Current installed1451 already routes await_ci through heard_ci; previous direct-call suspicion is superseded. Confirmed cache implementation rewrites one shared JSON map without read-modify-write exclusion, so concurrent merge keys can overwrite each other, and null event marks bypass reuse entirely. Reproduce these cases with isolated mocks; replace with indexed per-key persistent storage and same-key single-flight, preserving event invalidation and fresh polling cadence. Carry through release/install; no live proof or session signals.
